title: Anton sets course across the strait (paraphrase D)
topic: A sailor named Anton crosses a strait in a small boat; the wind blows from the north, a fishing boat crosses his course, the current pushes the boat south, Anton reaches the harbour before sunset
tail_E: To be sure of his heading Anton reads the needle of his
target_note: Same target as formulations A-C: 'compass' is the natural completion of 'reads the needle of his' in the strait-crossing context (course, wheel, sails, current); it does not occur in the units or the tail, nor does its German equivalent 'Kompass'. ' compass' is a single Pythia token (id 17066). Pilot check with pythia-160m (tail selection only, not a result): p(' compass') = 0.54 after the all-English context, rank 1 (next candidate ' watch' 0.09); 0.02 after the all-German context (rank 1 by a small margin) and rank 17 after the tail alone (0.006): the target is carried mainly by the context.
author: LS-NEQ stimulus bank, paraphrase D of family F10
notes: Formulation D: fourth independent re-phrasing of the ten F10A meaning units in both languages (same events, same order, same name Anton). Replacements include sails across the strait at dawn/sets course across the strait at sunrise (segelt über die Meerenge/nimmt Kurs über die Meerenge, Morgengrauen/Sonnenaufgang), wind blows from the north/wind blows steadily from the north (weht aus Norden/bläst gleichmäßig von Norden), waves strike the hull with great force/waves thunder against the hull with tremendous force (schlagen gegen den Rumpf mit großer Wucht/donnern gegen den Rumpf mit gewaltiger Wucht), holds the wheel with both hands/grasps the wheel with both of his hands (hält/umfasst das Steuerrad), fishing boat crosses his course to starboard/fishing cutter crosses his path to starboard (Fischerboot kreuzt seinen Kurs/Fischkutter kreuzt seinen Weg), lighthouse appears on the far shore/lighthouse rises on the other shore (erscheint am fernen Ufer/erhebt sich am anderen Ufer), seagull follows the boat for an hour/gull flies beside the boat roughly an hour (folgt dem Boot eine Stunde lang/fliegt neben dem Boot ungefähr eine Stunde), checks the sails every few minutes/watches the sails minute by minute (prüft alle paar Minuten/beobachtet Minute für Minute), current pushes the boat to the south/current drives the boat off to the south (treibt/versetzt das Boot nach Süden), reaches the harbour before sunset/sails into the harbour before the sun sets (erreicht den Hafen/fährt in den Hafen, vor Sonnenuntergang/noch vor Sonnenuntergang). 'compass' and 'Kompass' are absent. 'umfasst', 'beobachtet' and 'versetzt' are inseparable, 'erhebt sich' reflexive; no separable verbs ('übersetzen', 'aufbrechen', 'eintreffen' avoided). Present tense and positive polarity throughout. Unit 9 reads naturally in German; units 1 and 10 read naturally in English.
